basics.name: Pooya Rostami Mazrae
basics.label: Software Engineering Researcher
basics.summary: PhD researcher in software engineering focused on software engineering, software repository mining, and empirical studies of CI/CD and DevOps workflows.

work.name: University of Mons (UMONS)
work.summary: Doctoral research on the evolution of GitHub Actions automation workflows and empirical software engineering.
highlights: Conducted large-scale software repository mining using GitHub REST/GraphQL APIs and web scraping pipelines.
Performed mixed-method empirical studies including surveys, interviews, and qualitative coding.
Produced peer-reviewed publications, datasets, replication packages, and open-source tools.
Finalized doctoral dissertation and prepared for PhD defense.

work.name: Necko Technologies
work.summary: Engineer and data analyst working on cloud-native FinOps platforms on AWS.
highlights: Engineered a FinOps cost optimization platform based on AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR v2).
Designed and deployed serverless backends using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, RDS, and S3.
Developed RESTful API architectures and optimized data models and relational schemas.
Led backend architecture design for cloud-native systems.

work.name: Radboud University
work.summary: Visiting researcher in software engineering with a focus on qualitative methods.
highlights: Conducted mixed-method empirical studies under supervision of Dr. Mairieli Wessel.
Deepened expertise in qualitative methodologies, resulting in a peer-reviewed publication.

work.name: ISE Lab, Sharif University of Technology
work.summary: Research assistant working on software repository mining and traceability.
highlights: Designed pipelines for large-scale issue–commit linking research.
Applied ML models such as XGBoost, Decision Trees, and Random Forest for traceability tasks.

work.name: IIPL, K. N. Toosi University of Technology
work.summary: Intern software engineer and research assistant on data engineering projects.
highlights: Built ETL pipelines integrating public datasets and GitHub data.
Performed data cleaning, anomaly detection, and statistical validation.

volunteer.summary: Served as junior PC member for the International Conference on Technical Debt 2026.
Managed publicity for the BENEVOL workshop series.
highlights: Maintained the workshop website and external communications.

volunteer.summary: Delivered a full-session lecture on qualitative methodology for PhD students.
Peer reviewer for the Journal of Systems and Software.

education.summary: Thesis: "Understanding the Evolution of GitHub Actions Automation Workflows". Advisor: Prof. Tom Mens. Funded by a doctoral research scholarship (Bourse de Doctorant).

education.summary: Thesis: "Automatic Linking of Issue Reports and Commits in Software Repositories". Advisor: Dr. Abbas Heydarnoori.

awards.title: ICSME Distinguished Paper Award
awards.awarder: IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME)

projects.name: gawd – GitHub Actions Workflow Differ
projects.summary: Python library and CLI tool to compute structural differences between GitHub Actions workflows using syntax-aware comparison.
highlights: Detects added, removed, moved, renamed, or modified items in workflows.
Supports analysis of workflow evolution in large repositories.
